name: Photosynthetic Healing (3rd Party – Total Party Kill Games)
body:
You heal faster when in direct sunlight.

Prerequisites: Plant Type

Benefit: When exposed to direct sunlight, you regain hit points at a rate of 1d4 points per hour. You may also regrow lost limbs and other extremities in this fashion. A lost limb is regrown after regaining 25% of your maximum hit points.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
